viewing_check: Look at the backs: hallmark or 'Italy' stamp, 9ct/15ct/18ct gold (would make it antique and worth thousands) versus gilt brass with modern clip or hook fittings; check for lost tesserae and whether the mosaic is set in glue or metal bezel.
